additional_info.subject: RE: 0381386 - ID0381386-DC/Si-D/TR-[MP / R1 170001413] HMI is completely black CRM:00641000682
additional_info.body:
Dear Mr,Furkan,
I hope this message finds you well.
Regarding the reported issue, we understand that the HMI screen is black, although it is still receiving 24V power.
A site intervention should be planned to inspect the connections, as there may be a loose connection between KF1 and PH2. Please ensure that the DPP and USB connections used for the OC display and touch functionality are properly checked. And kindly check the supply voltage 24v,
Additionally, there is a possibility that the DPP or USB cable may be faulty. We recommend swapping them with working cables to confirm. If the issue persists after these checks, the screen will need to be replaced.
During the site visit, please bring a spare HMI, DPP, and USB cable in case replacements are necessary.
Kindly refer to the marked HMI schematic below, and also review the attached Q-feedback for troubleshooting.
https://support.industry.siemens.com/cs/document/109816666/si-e-q-feedback-q2302-sicharge-d-hmi-backlight-off-and-scrambled-image-due-to-router-emissions?dti=0&lc=en-WW
Please note, if the charger's DLogic is Gen2, then Q-feedback process will not apply.
For that we need to check the above connection.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Abhinav Malokar
